Three criteria sit at 6: artwork craft (relief reads as texture rather than landform on several frames, and reserved fields still read as plates), variety vs ledger (the palette lands in the series' default cold arctic register and the camera-over-relief-map chassis has shipped before at No.1 and No.8), and legibility (the progress counter is overprinted by coastline on slides 02 and 06). notes_for_the_ledger: The 'this was not AI, and that is the point' thesis is legitimate and honestly executed, but it earns the page's beat only by a nose. Slide 09 is where it strains, bridging to AI through one April Air Force acreage disclosure that shares no agency, no actor and no time window with the story. A future run taking a non-AI story should plant the AI bridge in the first three slides with a sourced in-window claim rather than parking it on a background item at the turn. The build reconciliation was right that the dossier's own elevation-keyed contrast rule created the dead-lower-third defect, but raising the floor to 0.62 traded a dead band for a flat one. Any encoding drawn as sub-2px marks at low opacity on a near-black field will not survive its own render. Reserved fields at 0.74 damping still read as plates; clip the reservation to the water or carry it full-bleed.
